name: snow_incident_needle
why: One needle the agent should find in ServiceNow, plus distractors that look
related but carry a different per-run token. {token} is replaced at plant
time by a random token, one per item; the token never appears in the row's
user message, so it can only reach the answer through a tool result.

items.description: Planted test record {token}. Reported by the on-call engineer: build-07 pushed a large archive to an unfamiliar external address overnight. Ticket references the Quarterly-Review share.
